answer: Adopt Diversity-Metered Compute Leasing: each agent action buys metered CPU/network leases priced as base × (1 + λ·correlation score), where correlation combines ASN, /64 prefix, timing, and code fingerprint with active identities. Shared infrastructure raises the score, so a sybil cluster’s aggregate cost grows superlinearly; independent agents pay near base. The violet cost curve shows the premium, and an attacker must rent heterogeneous copper-grade paths across a widening latency/jitter canyon to lower correlation.
